title: Record the chirp budget clearance
body:
## Summary
- All 7910 chirp phase rows, for precision 16 through 128, meet the width and guard inequalities. The error bill is 22 and the norm margin is 601/1000.
- The online power is 8/5 - 997/1000 = 603/1000. The stated Fourier power is 99827619697/100000000000, and both 603/1000 and 332353/332929 sit strictly below it.
- No new kappa. The middle-map consumer stays unrun.
